Catalog Game Guides 1000 Tysyacha Tysyacha (Тысяча), meaning 1000 in Russian, is a trick-taking card game popular in Eastern Europe: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Poland and the Baltic states. Three players use a 24-card deck (9 through Ace). Points come from card values and marriages... 11 Point Black Tile 11 Point Black Tile is a Hearts-style trick-taking game played with a double-six domino set. It uses negative scoring: the double-0 counts 4 points and each of the seven tiles in the 3-suit counts 1 point (11 points total per deal). Lower score wins. Three... 110 (One Hundred and Ten) 110 (One Hundred and Ten) is an Irish trick-taking game with bidding, related to Twenty-Five. Played with a standard 52-card deck; the first player or team to reach 110 points wins. Players score 5 points per trick. Card ranking varies by trump suit. 2-7 Triple Draw 2-7 Triple Draw (Deuce to Seven) is a lowball draw poker game where the lowest hand wins. Players get five cards and three drawing rounds to improve; straights and flushes count against you; aces are high. Best possible hand is 7-5-4-3-2 offsuit. 20 dominoes 20 dominoes can refer to domino games played with a 20-tile set or scoring to 20. Players command 'Stones' on a grid, attempting to capture the opponent's forces by surrounding them from two sides (Custodian Capture). Played by exactly five players with a massive 168-card deck, the game is a unique blend of card shedding and social deduction. Two 'Royals' (The Emperor and the hidden Eunuch) must clear their hands before the three 'Commoners' can stop them. Primarily played by children, it involves a 52-card deck distributed equally among players. The game is famous for its 'Payment' mechanic: when a face card is turned, the next player must pay a set number of cards. If another face card appears during payment, the obligation passes to the next player. Auction bidding + melding + trick-taking. Melds: K+Q same suit = 'marriage' (â™¥=100, â™¦=80, â™£=60, â™ =40). Declaring a marriage makes that suit trump. Card points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, 9=0. Total 120. First to 1000 wins. Musik (talon) taken by bid winner. 👥 2-4 🃏 24 cards ⏱ 45-60m ⚡ Mid 🎯 Trick-taking / Marriage / Ace-Ten COMING SOON 1000 Tysyacha Tysyacha (Тысяча), meaning 1000 in Russian, is a trick-taking card game popular in Eastern Europe: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Poland and the Baltic states. Three players use a 24-card deck (9 through Ace). Points come from card values and marriages (King-Queen of a suit), which also set trump. First to 1000 points wins. 👥 3 🃏 24 cards ⏱ 20-40m ⚡ Mid 🎯 Trick-taking / Trick-avoidance COMING SOON 11 Point Black Tile 11 Point Black Tile is a Hearts-style trick-taking game played with a double-six domino set. It uses negative scoring: the double-0 counts 4 points and each of the seven tiles in the 3-suit counts 1 point (11 points total per deal). Lower score wins. Three or four players pass three tiles left before play; the leader nominates the suit for each trick. 👥 3-4 🃏 Double-six domino s... ⏱ 15-30m ⚡ Beginner 🎯 Trick-taking / Point-trick with Bidding COMING SOON 110 (One Hundred and Ten) 110 (One Hundred and Ten) is an Irish trick-taking game with bidding, related to Twenty-Five. Played with a standard 52-card deck; the first player or team to reach 110 points wins. Players score 5 points per trick. Card ranking varies by trump suit. 👥 3-9 🃏 52 cards ⏱ 15-30m ⚡ Mid ♠ Poker / Lowball Draw COMING SOON 2-7 Triple Draw 2-7 Triple Draw (Deuce to Seven) is a lowball draw poker game where the lowest hand wins. Players get five cards and three drawing rounds to improve; straights and flushes count against you; aces are high. Best possible hand is 7-5-4-3-2 offsuit. 👥 2-8 🃏 52 cards ⏱ 15-30m ⚡ Mid ▯ Domino / Domino / Adding COMING SOON 20 dominoes 20 dominoes can refer to domino games played with a 20-tile set or scoring to 20. When played as a Blackjack-style game, it is similar to Twenty-One dominoes: players draw tiles aiming for a total of 20 or 21 without busting, with a banker. 👥 2-5 🃏 Double-six domino s... ⏱ 15-30m ⚡ Mid 🎯 Trick-taking / Trick-avoidance COMING SOON 21 Point Black Tile 21 Point Black Tile is a Hearts-style domino game using a double-six set: 21 penalty points per deal. Three or four players pass three tiles left; leader nominates suit each trick. Lowest total score wins. 👥 3-4 🃏 Double-six domino s... ⏱ 15-30m ⚡ Beginner ▯ Domino / Block / Line Game COMING SOON 27-28 dominoes 27-28 dominoes refers to block or draw domino games using a standard double-6 set of 28 tiles (0-0 through 6-6). Players draw 7 tiles each (4 players); highest double leads. Players match a number on an open end; doubles are placed crosswise. Cannot play: draw from boneyard or pass.
